properties.name: Every gate runs the binary it is told: one resolver, $REFLOW2_BIN first
properties.rationale: fact:every-gate-chose-its-own-binary-so-reflow2-bin-reached-one-of-them-2026-10-03. THE CLASS: each gate chose its binary by itself, so pointing the run at one build reached only the gates that happened to read the same variable. reflow2_check.py keeps its own copy of the order (plus PATH) because it is installed into consumer projects alone; the test checks it reads $REFLOW2_BIN first. Scripts outside ci.yml (bl124_instrument, erosion_trial, render_views and others) were left: they are instruments run by hand. The new test observed failing against main's three gate scripts.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: tools/reflow2_bin.py resolves the binary for every gate ci.yml runs ($REFLOW2_BIN, else the debug build, else the release build said on stderr); about twenty gates that hard-coded target/debug and two that read their own variables use it; run_ci_gates.py says which binary up front; test_run_ci_gates.py fails on any gate that names a binary path in code.
